caption: A hand is pressed into a slab of memory foam and lifted away, and the hand-shaped dent slowly fills back in.

sa.check: A hand is pressed into a slab of memory foam.
The dent slowly fills back in.
The press comes first, then the lift, then the dent fades.

pc.expect: The dent matches the hand, palm and fingers, and persists for a few seconds before disappearing gradually.
pc.fail: No dent forms under the hand; or the dent is a shapeless hollow unlike a hand; or the foam cracks.

pc.expect: The dent fills in slowly and steadily, neither instantly nor never.
pc.fail: The dent vanishes the instant the hand lifts; or it stays for the rest of the clip; or it deepens after the hand has gone.
The slab slides; or lifts; or jumps.

pc.expect: The dent is where the hand pressed.
pc.fail: A dent appears elsewhere; or the hand presses and leaves no mark; or the dent appears before the hand touches.

pc.expect: One slab keeps its number, and the hand does not pass through it.
pc.fail: The slab splits; or the hand passes through it; or a second slab appears.

pc.expect: The foam's colour and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The foam changes colour; or the hand changes; or the background rearranges.
